biotools.summary: stSNV is a comprehensive resource providing spatial single nucleotide variant (SNV) data across various human and mouse tissues and diseases. It offers a user-friendly interface and analysis tools for exploring spatial genetic heterogeneity and understanding SNV biological regulatory mechanisms.
